rav-beivai-bar-abaye.name: Rav Beivai bar Abaye
rav-beivai-bar-abaye.bio: Babylonian Amora cited in the Talmud as Rav Beivai bar Abaye, who here challenges Rabbi Yoḥanan’s derivation from the karet stated for one’s sister.
rav-beivai-bar-abaye.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a dark, neatly trimmed beard and a russet wool mantle, leaning forward with one finger raised as he presses an objection; background of a mud-brick study hall lit by an oil lamp.

rabbi-yona.name: Rabbi Yona
rabbi-yona.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel who led the academy at Tiberias together with Rabbi Yosei.
rabbi-yona.prompt: A sage of the Land of Israel in his 60s with a long white beard and a pale blue linen mantle, pointing to a verse in an open scroll; background of a stone study hall in Tiberias with the lake glimpsed through an arched window.
